Tangible Results

The Future of Field Accountability

In an industry where accuracy is compliance and trust is everything, Bluetooth flow meter automation sets the bar for operational excellence. Eliminate paperwork, close compliance gaps, and make every ounce of fluid movement visible from the field, straight to the regulators.

Ready for seamless, auditable fluid transfers? Discover how our platform brings real-time automation, accuracy, and peace of mind to every field operation.

title: Real-Time Well Verification
subtitle: Instant Compliance Validation for Injection Operations
teaser: Cross-reference injection sites against permitted wells database for instant verification before fluid disposal.
body:
Ensuring Compliance with Every Injection

The application cross-references each injection site against an up-to-date database of permitted wells, providing instant verification before any fluid disposal operation begins. This proactive approach prevents violations before they occur.

Verification Process

A core pillar of UIC compliance is ensuring that disposal activities only occur at properly permitted wells. Mistakenly or fraudulently injecting fluid at an unregistered or suspended site can result in immediate regulatory violations, fines, or environmental liabilities. Our application prevents such errors at the point of action through a robust system of real-time well verification.
  • Database Integration: Real-time connection to state and federal permit databases
  • GPS Correlation: Automatic matching of location to permitted well coordinates
  • Permit Status: Instant verification of current permit validity and restrictions
  • Volume Limits: Automatic checking against daily and monthly injection limits

Compliance Benefits

Manual well identification, relying on paper logs, memory, or loosely labeled infrastructure introduces unacceptable risk. State regulators maintain active well status databases, and operators must prove not only that fluids were injected but that they were injected at the correct and permitted site. Automating this verification adds a crucial compliance safeguard and greatly reduces human error. Since implementation, our clients have achieved 100% compliance rates with zero permit violations. The system continues to prevent potential violations through proactive alerts, saving operators millions in potential fines and protecting their operational licenses.

Advanced Features

The verification system includes predictive analytics that forecast permit expiration's and volume limit approaches, allowing operators to plan ahead and maintain continuous compliance. 

Real-Time Well Verification: Preventing Unauthorized Disposal Before It Happens

A core pillar of UIC compliance is ensuring that disposal activities only occur at properly permitted wells. Mistakenly or fraudulently injecting fluid at an unregistered or suspended site can result in immediate regulatory violations, fines, or environmental liabilities. Our application prevents such errors at the point of action through a robust system of real-time well verification.

The application maintains a synchronized database of permitted wells including metadata such as API number, lease name, operator, and well status (active, suspended, shut-in). This database is periodically pulled from state or operator APIs and stored locally on the mobile device to support offline operation.

Each well is defined as a geofenced polygon or precise coordinate location, tagged with its regulatory status. When a vehicle enters a site boundary, the app immediately attempts to match the current GPS coordinates to a known permitted well. This is done via a fast spatial index lookup followed by a geofencing algorithm to confirm boundary containment.

If no match is found, or if the well is flagged as inactive or suspended, the app prevents any UIC workflow from proceeding. In most deployments, this blocks the ability to initiate flow meter capture, sign tickets, or generate reports until the issue is resolved. Administrators are notified via backend alerting systems, and the event is logged for audit purposes.

To avoid false positives near the edge of overlapping or adjacent wells, the verification system includes a confidence zone buffer and time thresholding logic to ensure that fleeting GPS errors do not trigger a block. The verification step is also tied to driver authentication and site dwell time to ensure temporal alignment with valid disposal operations.

Track every load. Prove every move. Generate every form.

Automating TRRC and UIC Documentation

Accuracy, compliance, and efficiency without the paperwork.

Optics is the OverSiteAI platform for anything that moves by truck and must be accounted for. It tracks what is loaded and what is unloaded, where it went, who handled it, and when. Then it turns that field data into the records a regulator, a customer, or an auditor is going to ask for. UIC is one use case. Saltwater disposal is another. So is chemical transport, hazardous material hauling, and crude trucking. If a truck is carrying something a regulator cares about, Optics is built to track it and document it.

Field operations still rely on paperwork, screenshots, and after-the-fact reconciliation.

For many operators, the most important information about a load or transfer is still spread across handwritten tickets, driver notes, spreadsheets, text messages, and disconnected systems.

That creates risk. A missing timestamp, an incorrect volume, an unverified location, or a late form can cause billing disputes, compliance issues, audit exposure, and operational delays.

OverSiteAI changes that by capturing the event while it happens, not days later when someone is trying to reconstruct it.

From field activity to verified operational record.

OverSiteAI connects the truck, driver, site, volume, document, and console into one workflow. When a driver enters a geofenced site, the system can begin capturing location, time, site identity, load activity, meter readings, photos, signatures, and notes. When the transfer is complete, the record is packaged into the correct operational, billing, or regulatory format.

The result is a trusted digital record that shows:

  • who was there
  • where they were
  • when they arrived and left
  • what was loaded or unloaded
  • how much moved in or out
  • what documents were generated
  • what still needs review

Built for real field work.

GPS and Geofencing. Every route, site visit, and transfer event can be tied to a verified location. Geofences help confirm that the activity happened at the correct facility, lease, disposal well, tank battery, chemical yard, or customer location.

Volume and Transfer Tracking. Track amounts going in and out of a location, including disposal volumes, produced water, chemicals, crude oil, hazardous materials, or other transported fluids. Data can be entered by the driver, captured from connected devices, or reviewed in the console.

Offline Field Capture. Remote operations do not stop when the signal drops. The mobile app stores records locally and syncs with the OverSiteAI Operations Console once connectivity is restored.

Document Automation. Generate structured documents for regulatory, customer, billing, and internal workflows, including EPA, TRRC, UIC 28, and other configurable reporting formats.

Console Sync and Review. All field activity syncs into the OverSiteAI console, giving office teams real-time visibility into loads, drivers, sites, exceptions, missing data, document status, and operational trends.

Audit-Ready Records. Each event is tied to timestamps, location data, driver identity, site information, and supporting documentation, so records are easier to verify, review, and defend.

More than disposal compliance.

Saltwater Disposal. Track water hauls, disposal volumes, geofenced site activity, tickets, signatures, EP-9, EP-10, UIC documentation, and facility reporting.

Produced Water Hauling. Monitor water movement from lease to disposal or recycling facility with GPS-verified routes, transfer records, and volume reconciliation.

Chemical Transport. Document chemical deliveries, pickup events, signatures, photos, safety records, and customer-specific delivery requirements.

Hazardous Materials. Capture chain-of-custody details, driver activity, site verification, movement records, and required documentation for regulated materials.

Oil Trucking. Track crude oil pickup, delivery, volume movement, location history, tickets, and billing support from field to back office.

Facility and Yard Transfers. Manage inbound and outbound movements at SWDs, CTBs, tank batteries, chemical yards, disposal facilities, and industrial sites.

The bottom line.

Compliance is not supposed to be a thing you survive. Neither is billing. Neither is proving to a customer, an insurer, or a regulator that the load actually got from point A to point B the way it was supposed to. Optics turns the work itself into proof. The driver does the job. The truck moves the fluid. The form writes itself. The invoice writes itself. When the inspector shows up, or the customer disputes a charge, or an incident gets reviewed, the answer is already in the system.
